title: Mandala Rift at the ghat
prompt: Make a new cinematic establishing painting for YUGA Mandala Rift, rebuilding the environment in the supplied illustrated map as a single immersive view from human height at the west ghat looking east toward a working stepped temple pavilion and cloth market. Wide landscape composition, art-direction keyframe in an original painterly 3D action game. Front left: three asymmetrical curved honey sandstone ribs like a comb with a suspended antique bell, at the apron of large wet stone ghat steps in malachite-coloured water, white lotus flecks. Middle foreground dry circular stone hearth, extremely small caged brass ember at centre. To the right a raised copper sluice wheel, a square wood weighbeam, muted madder and indigo hand-dyed awnings. Warm low sun after monsoon rain, clouds reflect in puddles, shadow colour cool teal, luminous rim light discovers chisel marks, chipped red sandstone edges, copper patina and damp wood. Background an airy compact four-tier receding south Indian tower (vimana-inspired, fictional), jungle silhouette. Surfaces are hand-crafted and clearly different at game camera distance. Strong, clear shape rhythm and restful play surfaces. Craft a finished striking environmental matte painting, visually tangible and worldly. No people in foreground, no lettering, emblems, title typography, panel borders, captions, infographic, UI, or watermark. The supplied prior concept sets the place and palette; take the viewer down into this one street-level perspective. Native landscape canvas.
